captions_note: the words above the grid carry the line: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while the sheet is up (work/reel_captions.json). Set the STYLE block to the reel's caption style
in_a_reel: one continuous shot, about 3 s, the sheet on a phrase of about 1.5 s: the cells are this shot's own frames and the dive lands back in it
the buyer's style wins: set STYLE (font, case, ink, and a ground colour from the reel's look) before the first build
fits a line about time or amount (hours, every second, how much work): the sheet is the picture of it
steps: edit STYLE, and LINES or T_IN / T_DIVE in the CLIP block when the defaults do not land
run build.py SAFE=1      # pulls the frames, prints the beats and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
